title: Labor and Parts fields at rest and on hover look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both set to that staff member.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-09-n1-added.png" (board 1.9), "card-10-n1-added-hover.png" (board 1.10) and "card-11-n1-labor-list.png" (board 1.11) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the two fields with the picture of board 1.9.
  2. Hover over the rows and compare with the picture of board 1.10.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Labor" and compare the open list with the picture of board 1.11.
  4. Close the list.
  5. Make the window 1536 px wide.
  6. Hover over the rows and compare with the picture of board 1.10 again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Sales Representative - Labor" shows above "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Both labels show in full.
  • Both are plain at rest.
  • There is 16 px between all fields, as in the picture.

Step 2:

  • Both boxes show at once.
  • Each arrow sits in the bottom-right corner of its field, on the name line.
  • The remove x (32 px, 20 px x icon, grey) shows beside Parts only.
  • Nothing shows beside Labor.
  • There is no +.

Step 3:

  • The list opens under Labor, with "Unassigned" first, as in the picture.
  • The person on the Parts row is not hidden.

Step 4:

  • The list closes.

Step 5:

  • The window is 1536 px wide.
  • With the pointer away from the rows, the two fields look the same as in step 1 (compare with the picture of board 1.9 again).
  • Nothing overlaps.

Step 6:

  • The look is the same as in step 2.
  • Nothing overlaps.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”
  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R8: “A remove x sits to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", in the column the + uses: the same Tertiary button, 32px square, showing the Lucide x icon at 20px, grey at rest with a light fill on hover.”
  • S2-R10: “While the two fields show, the + is not shown, because there is nothing left to add. "Sales Representative - Labor" has no button beside it.”
  • S2-R14: “Both labels show in full on the card, never cut off.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

  • Design — board 1.10 title: “1.10 Hover: two rows”

  • Design — board 1.11 title: “1.11 Labor: pick who sold the labor”
  • Design — board 1.11 note: “With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70). Each row has the same list: Unassigned first, then the reps. A person already on the other row is not hidden (decision 67).”
